purpose: Independent confirmation that the public entry serves HTTP on the IP and that 443 no longer accepts connections, because the local machine's own TCP/TLS probes are unreliable here.
why_local_probes_are_unreliable: This workstation resolves or routes external TCP through a proxy that answers with a synthetic 198.18.0.0/15 address. aihyb.com resolved to 198.18.3.79 and a local connect to 5.231.253.4:443 completed against local=198.18.0.1 before TLS failed, so a local 'port open' result says nothing about the server.

third_party_tcp_80.note: us2.node.check-host.net timed out; one blocked route is a network path issue, not a server listener

conclusion: Plain HTTP on the IP is reachable from independent networks; TLS on 443 is refused.
